overloads.semanticRole: The Get string resource command returns the string stored in the string (“STR ”) resource whose ID is passed in resID .

constraints: If resFile is omitted, the first matching STR resource found in the resource files chain is returned; if passed, only that file is searched.
Returns an empty string and sets the OK system variable to 0 if the resource is not found.
A STR resource is limited to 255 characters.
